title: ui: simplify signal path with separate HEAD and CAB stages
body:
## Disposition
**Draft — implementation prepared; acceptance blocked. Do not include this source in the October 14 test candidate.**

The exact-source macOS SignalPath CI failed an automation/routing-refresh assertion. Windows and Linux passed, but those results do not qualify the failing platform. Keep this separate development PR in the next weekly work slot: **October 21 test → October 22 candidate → October 23 `1.3.1-beta.3` target**, conditional on the corrected source’s verification and installed acceptance. PR #55 has not been written to or merged by this task.

## Why and result
The old compact strip repeats global utilities and crowds routine editing. The revised compact workflow is:

**PRE → HEAD → CAB → TONE EQ → POST → FINAL EQ**, followed by **ROUTING**.

| Entry | Destination |
| --- | --- |
| HEAD | Current mode’s existing aggregate amplifier controls: Classic one, Dual two, Matrix three. Existing per-lane CAB shortcuts remain. |
| CAB | Current mode’s existing cabinet room; the user selects a lane for detailed cabinet editing. No arbitrary first-lane modal. |
| PRE / Tone EQ / POST / Final EQ | Their existing editing workspaces. |
| ROUTING | Complete detailed signal path, utility positions/taps, parallel branches, rig sums and lane-specific navigation. |

Remove compact Input, Gate, Transpose, Utilities and Output. Keep the established top Gate/Transpose controls and footer Tuner. Tuner was already absent from the compact strip. Both Dual Blend and Crossover remain supported.

Navigation synchronizes compact and detailed selection immediately, including the legacy room/controls toggle and RIGS tab. The navigation callback owns its Node value while views refresh. Keep the existing cabinet-room startup and rig-mode-switch default; PRE/POST/EQ retain their global editor through mode changes.

Stable button identities preserve focus. Tab/Shift-Tab order, Return, focused unmodified Space, native button roles/actions and accessible titles with mode context are covered. This does not claim installed Narrator/VoiceOver acceptance.

## Exact source and scope
**Source: `fc54ab94d40e525006c474d3f1f93ce6bffa688b`**  
**Tree: `65b2a39cda2e592f3e187dccf9216f36d5eb8360`**

The before/after baseline remains `e7b00cb09c5431d86c03282392eafddbe8edbfdd`. During this work, #55 independently advanced to `c3e9d436fbdc9b8778b592f333c93037b012b8c5`, incorporating its naming and document/installer maintenance.

The previous UI source’s Windows Product job failed before compilation because the newer evaluated workflow required `Tools/Verify-WindowsPreviousReleaseUpgrade.ps1`, absent from that older checkout. This development branch therefore merges the existing c3 integration base as second parent; first parent is `60fc8ecb84f8e3e2df99a986bf2a7ab0b4f5415f`. The merge was conflict-free. This did not modify #55.

Against c3, the feature is **eight UI/test/documentation files**. Production changes are confined to `Source/SignalPathView.h` and `Source/PluginEditor.cpp/.h`. All other Source files, DSP/routing authority, parameter/preset definitions and serialization are inherited unchanged, as are Tools, workflows, installers, policies, receipts and historical evidence. `Source/SignalPath.h` is also unchanged against the original e7 baseline. Upstream public-caption/host-display naming changes belong to c3; this feature introduces none.

## Verification for fc54
### Completed
- **32 offline commands PASS.** The 17 unittest suites discovered 357 cases: **353 executed/pass, four existing platform/environment skips** (three Windows-only packaging cases and one isolated ownership case). Includes version/package/publication/weekly/raw-evidence/catalog/IR contracts and current public-name/document/cleanup regressions. Source stayed clean at completion.
- **Local native SignalPath PASS on its first test execution, 112.56s.** All **49/49 expected PNGs** passed full chunk/CRC/IEND/decode checks. Root directly inspected five representative current-source HEAD/CAB/detail captures.
- **Normal Linux SignalPath CI: 8/8 CTests PASS**, including NativeFocus. The original archive’s API source/run/attempt, digest/size, ZIP CRC, build manifest, JUnit and **53/53 PNGs** were verified. Representative visual review covered all modes/scales; some captures contain transient native tooltips overlapping room/rig headers.
- **Windows SignalPath CI: 7/7 CTests PASS**, confirmed by the original job log (SignalPath126.29s, total338.90s). Direct Windows archive/JUnit/PNG inspection was blocked by the local runtime outage and is not claimed.

### Blocking macOS failure
[SignalPath run38341744958, attempt1](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38341744958), [macOS job115114298383](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38341744958/job/115114298383):

- `ChimeraSignalPathUITests` **FAIL after9.29s**, first Classic scenario0/0: `Compact presentation hid the actual automated routing snapshot`.
- The assertion checks the cached view after utility automation and `settle(100)`. Source inspection narrows the failed condition to the post-gate `merge → gate` edge not yet being represented.
- A nearby macOS native event-pump diagnostic reports requested35ms versus actual433.22ms. Cached refresh/event delivery or fixture scheduling is a hypothesis, **not a proven root cause or grounds to dismiss the failure as a flake**.
- The other **six macOS CTests passed**. The early-abort artifact is partial; no full macOS screenshot/JUnit archive validation is claimed.
- No rerun, threshold/deadline relaxation or speculative production change was used to conceal this failure.

### Other CI and remaining verification
At the disposition snapshot, **six workflows succeeded, SignalPath failed, and Product/Update remained in progress**. All are attempt1 on fc54. The original run/job/artifact metadata records the exact observation time. Those two workflows continue normally; they have not been cancelled.

The required policy set remains Product, Update candidate, CAB Panel, CAB realtime, amplifier head controls, SignalPath and graphical EQ. Niflheimr audition and publisher contracts are additional triggered checks. Document Upgrade has its own path filter and did not run for the eight-file UI delta; older-source success is not reused.

The failed required workflow blocks qualification regardless of the other results. The final Python CI/gate verifier and matching package payload review were not executed after the local runtime disconnected. Existing contract tests passing does not establish installed-product or publication approval.

### Local runtime limitation
The local pre-feature audit found a zero-byte generated object; its targeted repair and 371-object audit passed before the successful feature run. A later pre-regression audit found another zero-byte object and blocked test launch. During its targeted repair, a compiler reported a missing generated dependency-file directory, followed by execution-service disconnection and `environment_offline`.

The additional six local CTests **never started**. Source/assertions/deadlines were unchanged. Earlier logs were written locally; final disk/process state and raw-file export cannot be confirmed while that environment is unavailable. Observed summaries are distinguished from original GitHub logs/API records.

## Remaining acceptance and follow-up
1. Diagnose the macOS cached-routing update failure with explicit phase/actual-state evidence, implement only a demonstrated fix, and freeze a new full source SHA.
2. Re-run all required exact-source CI and release contracts for that source; inspect source-matching manifests, package names/hashes, original evidence, portable payload and update-feed entries. Do not relabel fc54 or parent results as a corrected source’s evidence.
3. Complete installed DAW pointer/keyboard/navigation, recall and window lifecycle; actual Narrator/VoiceOver; previous-version upgrade/repair/removal and personal IR/preset preservation.
4. Bind any eventual public approval to the selected version/SHA and existing policy/map fingerprints. Approval receipts, version reservations and publication policy remain unchanged here.

The implementation is reviewable, but **October14 inclusion and public release are not approved**. A new merge/squash/rebase or any additional product/document/policy/workflow change selecting another SHA requires matching verification again.

<details>
<summary>Historical sources remain separately attributed</summary>

- `60fc8ecb84f8e3e2df99a986bf2a7ab0b4f5415f`: seven unique local CTests ultimately passed; feature109.09s and49/49 PNGs;27 offline commands passed(287 executed cases,3 Windows-only skips). Its [Windows Product job](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38340148888/job/115110886472) failed on the absent newer packaging script. Artifact-repair and interrupted/resumed local attempts were retained separately.
- `bb0c420f0f4d5aeb21f7e4d6ccae17e1938b08a4` exposed accessible-title defects; `10db019def8c39dfbf97549ef1c098bbe2b8dfef` and labeled diagnostics exposed selection synchronization gaps. The corresponding fixes did not relax assertions/deadlines.
- `e27e60769104c2b5606717fb9f793a4995da3f69` was the earlier five-stage revision with one combined rig button; its success does not certify the HEAD/CAB split.

</details>

[Baseline comparison and acceptance scope](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/blob/fc54ab94d40e525006c474d3f1f93ce6bffa688b/docs/SIGNAL_PATH_WORKFLOW_SIMPLIFICATION.md).
